projectDescription: A C++ program that parses propositional logic formulas (or DIMACS CNF files) into a binary expression tree and performs traversals, height computation, and truth table generation.
keyFeatures: Parse infix propositional logic formulas with NOT (~), OR (+), AND (*), and implication (>) operators
Load formulas from DIMACS CNF files
Build a binary expression tree from parsed formulas
Tree traversals: pre-order, in-order, and post-order (both recursive and iterative)
Compute tree height recursively and iteratively
Generate full truth tables for formulas with up to 16 variables
publicApiSurface: PropositionalTree(string infix_expr) — construct from infix formula string
PropositionalTree(ifstream& file) — construct from DIMACS CNF file
infixToPrefix() — convert parsed infix tokens to prefix notation
buildTreeFromPrefix() — build binary tree from prefix representation
